purpose: Determine whether next-close delay misses or avoids entry-session return; gross event diagnostics only, not an executable cash account.
cache_rule: Run only after active54 finishes; verify cache bytes against its saved manifest and original source identities; no rebuild or signal adjustment.
reference: SPY same timing and horizons, separate exposure-free event reference
signal_date_cutoff: Require calendar t+1+5 no later than last_session for every horizon; do not require future prices to select candidates.
candidate_selection: At every signal date, original stable score rank; plan_entries with USD2000 NAV,USD2000 available cash,no held/reserved names,five slots,original40bps proportional reference cost. Reuse its reference-price whole-share/ATR/cap choices across all horizons and timings; ignore future open availability when selecting; no replacement after missing outcomes.
adjusted_open: provider_raw_open * provider_adjusted_close / provider_raw_close, all from the same symbol/session/raw response; do not combine nominal reconstructed close with provider open.
signal_gap: log(Oadj[t+1]/Cadj[t]); attribution only, not available to a close+1minute signal
costs: No fills,spread,fees,impact,taxes,FX or reinvestment cash modeled; gross price-event diagnostics only.
coverage_policy: Retain every planned date-symbol event; missing/invalid opens or source hashes are reported,not imputed; never rerank or substitute another instrument because of future data.
cell_validation: Same-source arrays align to timestamps; unique exchange session;finite positive required values;raw open and close within same-source low/high;finite positive close-adjustment factor. Inconsistency invalidates relevant cell,not signal membership.
aggregation: Primary entry-day log return uses complete active dates (all selected entry-day open/close pairs valid),equal-stock within date then equal-date; report individual-event and available-pair summaries secondarily with denominators. No-signal days reported separately,not treated as profitable zero returns.
uncertainty: Exploratory paired date bootstrap,2000 circular10-date blocks,seed1729; repeated hypotheses/previously seen data acknowledged. The common-exit log timing difference is algebraically identical across holds,so only9primary paired hypotheses.
source_policy: Original frozen raw sources unchanged; verified sample only proves practical open availability. AIXI and other source/action issues remain; paired entry-day ratio cancels subsequent adjustments algebraically but is not independent vendor validation.
